title: OpenMuCF: open FAIR rate ledger and auditor for muon-catalyzed fusion, and external muonic-atom data for Geant4
description:
OpenMuCF is open, reproducible, differentiable, uncertainty-bearing infrastructure for the muon-catalyzed-fusion (μCF) cycle: a FAIR rate ledger with per-row provenance, conditions, uncertainty, established/contested tags and validity ranges; a JAX/diffrax cycle-kinetics and net-electrical energy-balance engine; and a global Sobol/forward-UQ auditor that turns point-estimate breakeven claims into error-barred, falsifiable verdicts.

It also ships Geant4 muonic-atom data as an external, versioned dataset, with provenance and uncertainty attached, that a patched Geant4 consults only after an explicit opt-in: the G4MuonicData external-data format; D1, nuclear capture; D2, the capturing-atom selector and the atomic-capture reference corpus; the D3 energy tables of the mudirac130 profile; patches for Geant4 v11.4.2 and v11.5.0.beta; and a transport workflow that builds each revision the patches name with and without them. docs/geant4-developers.md says how to try it, what has been checked and what building it showed about Geant4 itself.

The archive's files carry licences by path, given in the notes.
notes: All related identifiers use relation 'references' because OpenMuCF is standalone infrastructure, not supplementary material to any single paper. The Toyama et al. (Science Advances 12, 2026) 'Direct observation of muonic molecules...' record is included by its published DOI 10.1126/sciadv.aed3321 (verified against CrossRef 2026-07-13; it has no arXiv ID). If this software is ever published as a supplement to a specific paper, change that paper's relation to 'isSupplementTo'. The archive's files carry licences by path, so the record's licence is Other (Open): Apache-2.0 for code (LICENSE); CC-BY-4.0 for data (LICENSE-DATA); the Geant4 Software License for the Geant4 patch files under cpp/patches/ (cpp/patches/LICENSE) and the vendored Geant4 files under third_party/geant4/.
